hermit.summary: A kind old hermit with a long white beard, elf ears, a brown robe, a gnarled stick, and a bowl of red berries. The identity matches the mockup, but the hood shape and the nose are clearly different.
strengths: The long white beard, the white eyebrows, and the elf ears match the mockup and read from the front.
The robe colors match the mockup: brown robe, tan hem, green sash, rope belt, and pouch.
The gnarled dark stick and the red berry bowl are clear signature props.
The 128 px sprites keep the beard, the stick, and the berries in every direction.
issues: The hood is a tight cap with a tall bent point at the back. From the side and the back it reads as a gnome hat. Make a soft hood that frames the face and falls to the shoulders, as in the mockup.
The nose is small and the mustache hides it. Make the large round nose of the mockup, because it is a main trait of the face.
The berry bowl is at the waist. Lift the bowl to chest height and move it forward, as in the mockup.
The walk is stiff. The robe hides the legs and the upper body has little bob.
hermit.next: Replace the pointed cap with a soft hood that frames the face and falls to the shoulders.

ferryman.summary: A calm old ferryman with a wide straw hat, a gray beard, a teal shirt, a long pole, and an orange lantern. The model matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The wide conical straw hat gives a strong silhouette from every view and in every sprite.
The teal shirt, the brown belt, the sandals, and the low orange lantern match the mockup.
The long pole fits the ferryman role and the fist holds it.
The face is calm and friendly, and the curly hair and beard read under the hat.
issues: The hair and the beard are cool gray. The mockup has warm gray-brown hair and a longer, fuller beard. Warm the color and lengthen the beard to the chest.
The nose is small. Make the nose larger and rounder, as in the mockup.
The trousers are dark navy and long. The mockup has brown knee-length shorts. Change the color to brown and shorten them.
The walk is stiff and the pole arm does not move.
ferryman.next: Make the beard longer and fuller and change the hair and beard to warm gray-brown.

chieftain.summary: A young highland chieftain with red braids, a gold circlet, a fur-trimmed green cloak, and a sun staff. The model matches the mockup with small differences only.
strengths: The red hair, the two braids, and the gold circlet match the mockup.
The face has a closed smile and rosy cheeks, and it reads as proud and kind.
The bronze sun staff is a clear focal accent and reads in every sprite.
The color plan matches the mockup: red-brown tunic with gold trim, green cloak, and cream fur.
issues: The cloak flares into a wide bell that touches the ground. From the side and the back it is larger than in the mockup. Make the cloak narrower and stop it at the calf.
The boots are plain brown. Add the cream fur cuffs of the mockup.
The staff wood is light and twisted. The mockup staff is darker carved wood. Darken the wood.
The walk is stiff. The cloak hides the legs and the staff arm does not move.
chieftain.next: Make the cloak narrower and shorter so that the side and back silhouette matches the mockup.

ranger-guide.summary: A young ranger guide in a green hooded cloak, with a braid, a brass compass, a staff, and a bow and quiver on the back. The identity matches the mockup, but a visible defect at the cloak hem caps the rating.
strengths: The green hood, the front braid, and the raised brass compass match the mockup.
The bow and the quiver on the back read in the side view, the back view, and the sprites.
The face is friendly and confident, with rosy cheeks.
The leather straps, the belt, and the boots give clear material contrast.
issues: Thin dark ring lines show inside the cloak hem around the legs in the front view. Remove or close the thin shell that makes these lines.
The lower garment is cream and short. The mockup has brown trousers into the boots. Change it to brown trousers.
The mouth is open. The mockup has a closed smile. Close the mouth.
The walk is stiff and the staff arm does not move.
ranger-guide.next: Remove the dark ring lines inside the cloak hem.

watch-captain.summary: A friendly watch captain with a steel kettle helmet, a red plume, a blue tabard, a raised lantern, and a mace. The pose and the silhouette match the mockup, but the skin, the hair, and the cheek guards are clearly different.
strengths: The kettle helmet with the red plume gives a strong silhouette and reads in every sprite.
The raised lantern pose matches the mockup.
The blue tabard with a gold emblem, the mail sleeves, and the steel pauldrons read as a town guard.
The face has a friendly smile and reads at 128 px from the front.
issues: The skin is light peach. The mockup has medium brown skin. Change the default skin to match the mockup.
The cheek guards are flat plates that float at the temples below the brim. Attach them to the helmet brim and let them hang down along the cheeks.
The hair is short and curly. The mockup has hair to the shoulders under the helmet. Lengthen the hair.
The lantern is small and the glow is weak. Make the lantern larger with a bright amber glow, because it is the focal prop.
The walk is stiff and the lantern arm does not move.
watch-captain.next: Change the default skin to the medium brown of the mockup and attach the cheek guards to the helmet.
